per_record_gate: Static source-hash, approval, review-index, derived-metric freshness, and existing-evidence screen; zero Racket labels.
For records passing the static screen, retain one 3-demo + 4-distinct-query episode and execute all seven labels in canonical Racket.
Use exact public_challenge_bytes/public_challenge_id and reject duplicate visible challenges before counting a success.
Only the top three unambiguous records receive one paired parameter setting, adding seven labels each; proposals remain non-production.
alternative_allocation.stopping_rule: Stop at ten records. Do not scale the alternative if fewer than 7/10 records yield source-current, duplicate-free, Racket-verified four-query episodes; if any stratum has zero successes; or if more than 2/10 labels are ambiguous/unverified. Stop a stratum early after two consecutive source/evidence freshness failures. No audit is auto-cleared.

Current packet selection intentionally emphasizes unfinished approved originals, while mix weights serve export sampling and do not certify quality. All three sampled records lack current parametric manifests; two retain open audits with materially different content, and all three historical derived catalog rows lag current source versions.
